Subject: Project timeline update: new delivery date April 14

We're writing to share an update on the project timeline. The third-party integration required for this phase has taken longer to certify than the vendor originally estimated, and that certification step is outside our direct control. As a result, the delivery date has moved by two weeks, with the project now scheduled for completion on 14 April.

The engineering team is continuing work on all components that don't depend on the certification, so this delay will not create additional downstream slippage once the integration clears. We're also maintaining daily contact with the vendor to track certification progress closely and will flag immediately if anything changes further.

Does the new date of 14 April work on your end, or are there downstream commitments we should factor into how we sequence the remaining work? We're glad to set up a short call this week to walk through the revised plan and answer any questions.
